en: Black‑and‑white view over a large cobblestoned town square bordered by 3‑ to 4‑storey historic buildings with gabled roofs. The facades bear large German inscriptions, including a dairy, distillation business, and a hotel named "Hotel zum Goldenen Engel". Horse‑drawn carts and a few pedestrians stand on the square, which has a small group of trees and a lamp post in the center. Behind the town stretches a gently rolling agricultural landscape with scattered farmhouses.
